request.spec:
When a claim is opened it receives the next number on the sheet: 1 for the first claim ever
opened on the sheet, then 2, and so on, with no gaps and never reused, even when two users open
claims at the same moment. A draft has no number, and voiding a claim clears its number (the
number is not given to anyone else). Show the number on the claim. Every audit line about a
claim that has a number gains number=<number> at its end (so CLAIM_OPENED and CLAIM_SETTLED
carry it; a CLAIM_VOIDED line carries the number the claim had).

AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Claims now get a number when they're opened, and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the numbering spec. That covers the two users opening claims at the same moment and getting 3 and 4.

**How it works:**
- **Storage:** a new migration, `V8__claim_number.sql`, gives each sheet a counter of the last number it handed out (starting at 0). Each claim gets a `claim_number` column that can be empty, and no two claims on a sheet can share a number.
- **Giving out numbers:** when a claim is opened, `SheetService.nextClaimNumber` adds one to the sheet's counter in a single database update, then reads the new value back. While one user is doing this, a second user opening a claim on the same sheet waits until the first finishes, so no number is skipped or given twice. If the open is refused or fails, the counter goes back to where it was, so that doesn't leave a gap either.
- **Voiding:** voiding a claim clears its number. The counter never goes down, so the number isn't given to anyone else.
- **Audit:** an audit line gets ` number=<n>` at the end whenever the claim has a number. `CLAIM_VOIDED` carries the number the claim had just before it was voided. Drafts, including `CLAIM_ADDED` lines and voided drafts, get no number field.
- **Screen:** each claim row shows its number in `claim-number`, and the field is empty when the claim has none.

`CLAIM_EDITED` will also carry the number if a claim that has one is edited, since the request says every line about a numbered claim gains it. The test only edits drafts, so that case isn't checked.
